## Scope
Existing URB ID (avoid duplicates), phase, owner role and dependencies.

## Observed and expected behavior
Include source/runtime versions and a minimal synthetic reproducer.

## Acceptance and verification
Positive case, denied/failure case, migration/recovery and resource bounds where relevant.

## Evidence and remaining work
Clearly separate executed, mocked and unexecuted checks.

Do not post keys, private piers, customer content or live vulnerability details. Read SECURITY.md.
